per_phase_nfrs.phase_name: Cash Deposit Receipt and AML Threshold Reporting
per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.5% — branch systems; planned maintenance during closed hours

security.data_classification: PII + Financial — customer identity, cash amount
security.access_control: Branch staff authenticated to branch POS system; transaction linked to staff_id for audit
security.audit: Cash deposit with AML threshold flag and staff_id logged immutably

security.access_control: Account credit initiated by branch system on behalf of verified customer

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Cash Transaction Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: CashDepositTransaction records retained for minimum 5 years per MLR 2017 record-keeping requirements.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: MLR 2017 Regulation 40 requires transaction records for AML compliance.

regulatory_slas.name: MLR 2017 Regulation 37 — Enhanced Vigilance for Cash
regulatory_slas.requirement: For cash transactions above £10,000, enhanced vigilance measures apply. AML cash threshold report must be generated and reviewed by MLRO.
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: FCA enforcement; failure to report suspicious activity may constitute a POCA 2002 offence
